result_summary.claim_boundary: The retained result proves only that the packet-bound downstream film-input release is blocked for the declared states. It does not validate bulk equilibrium, detailed balance, kinetics, transport, film flux, uncertainty propagation, packed-column capture, or the manuscript.
limitations: The immutable bundle is available and its hashes are verified, but no state has the complete concentration mapping, kinetic closure, and transport intersection required for release.
Issue 40 retains five basis_unresolved rows and admits zero true-species rows; its Position 1 packet evaluation remains diagnostic only.
Issue 41 retains source-faithful rate evidence but admits zero kinetic states because row-level observations and provider activity closure are unavailable; F3 remains unavailable.
Issue 42 retains 13 transport records but admits zero Candidate A/B transport states because source-complete ionic inputs and a complete unequal-ion mobility law are unavailable.
No v2 release files are created, and downstream issue #30 remains blocked.

case_results.required_evidence: Packet-bound equilibrium liquid and gas-film zero-fugacity-drive closure with zero signed CO2 flux.
case_results.non_execution_reason: Issue 36 admits zero physical film-input states; the zero-drive calculation cannot be evaluated without an admitted packet-bound state.

case_results.required_evidence: Admitted film inputs and analytic two-film signed-flux comparison with finite reaction sources disabled.
case_results.non_execution_reason: Issue 36 admits zero physical film-input states; the no-reaction comparison cannot be evaluated.

case_results.required_evidence: Retained linear fugacity-composition reference compared with complete signed flux.
case_results.non_execution_reason: Issue 36 admits zero physical film-input states; the linear-limit comparison cannot be evaluated.

case_results.required_evidence: Admitted reverse-driving state with physically correct negative CO2 transfer direction.
case_results.non_execution_reason: Issue 36 admits zero physical film-input states; no reverse-driving physical state may be invented.

case_results.required_evidence: Source rate states used by the accepted kinetics and transport leaves.
case_results.non_execution_reason: The accepted Issue 36 result has no admitted concentration, kinetic, or transport intersection for a film-rate evaluation.

case_results.required_evidence: At least one independent rate observation in each available lean, middle, and rich admitted class, compared on its source area and driving-force basis.
case_results.non_execution_reason: Zero admitted Issue 36 film-input states means no independent observed-versus-calculated film rate can be compared.

case_results.required_evidence: All 21 retained Case 3C axial stress states that lie inside the admitted temperature, concentration, and loading domain.
case_results.non_execution_reason: Issue 36 admits zero physical film-input states; the 21-state application stress set cannot be launched.

decision.reason: Zero admitted physical states is incomplete evidence; Issue 36 blocks the film-input dependency and Issue 19 supplies neither a reviewed completion nor an investigator-approved campaign budget.

downstream.reason: Issue 30 has no admitted film validation result and therefore cannot authorize the coupled column adoption decision.

claim_boundary: The retained result supports only the Issue 30 supported-negative no-run decision. It does not validate limiting behavior, desorption, numerical convergence, initialization, rate observations, film flux, packed-column capture, or a model disagreement.
limitations: Issue 36 is accepted as a supported-negative packet-bound release result with zero admitted states and no version-2 input, schema, or receipt files.
Issue 19 remains open and has no investigator-approved timing campaign budget; no physical BVP campaign is authorized.
No timeout or failed state is retained as a physical disagreement because no physical state was launched.
The result blocks column replacement and downstream Issue 31 execution until an independent, source-admitted film validation result exists.
